answer: Make rewards depend on a scarce, non-transferable work record rather than on how many identities an operator controls. Each agent must complete verifiable tasks that independent peers attest, so trust grows only through real work over time. A nebula of fresh accounts looks impressive, but without attested history each one is empty; an oasis earns its reputation drop by drop, and a tide of cheap copies cannot wash that history away. Cloning identities multiplies accounts, not proof, so sybils gain no extra share while honest agents keep theirs.
